settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
All of our Gift Sets are packaged in our stylish & fully recyclable packaging.

Our Gift sets come in the following flavours:

  • Passion Fruit - Sweet and tangy liqueur with a distinct tropical aroma.
  • Aperitivo - Our Italian aperitif perfectly combines specially selected herbs and fresh citrus fruits to create the delicious balance of bitter, sweet and fruity.
  • Tough Nut - The perfect balance between sweet nougat and delicious hazelnut. A liqueur that is great for all occasions.
  • Sticky Toffee - Caramel in its best form; as liqueur! The finely melted sugar creates an incomparable taste experience.
  • Very Cherry - Rounded off with a hint of vanilla and the taste of freshly picked cherries, Very Cherry is sure to be a favourite. 
  • Lemon Drizzle - Fresh lemon paired with notes of apple & grapefruit make our Lemon Drizzle Moonshine aromatic and refreshing.
  • Blood Orange - Our summer flavour Blood Orange makes every day feel like a holiday in Sicily.
  • Wild Berry - The refreshing summer flavour of raspberries, currants & blackberries creates this beautifully sweet and fruity liqueur.
  • High Proof - Triple distilled and filtered, our 50% ABV High Proof Moonshine is one of the smoothest spirits on the market.

settings.heading: Allergens
settings.content:
All of our Moonshines, unless indicated otherwise, are allergen free in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 and amendments. Most of our products are suitable for vegans and all are suitable those with a gluten intolerance.

Please note: Tough Nut Cream contains milk and dairy products and is therefore not suitable for vegans or people with dairy allergies.
